## Darknet.isDarknetServer() method

Returns whether the server is a darknet server. Defaults to the running script's server if host is not specified.

Returns false if the server does not exist or has gone offline.

**Signature:**

```typescript
isDarknetServer(host?: string): boolean;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  host | string | _(Optional)_ Optional. Hostname for the requested server object. |

**Returns:**

boolean

true if the server is a darknet server, false otherwise.

## Remarks

RAM cost: 0.05 GB
